The '''''Besh''-type personal starfighter''' was a [[Starship/Legends|craft]] whose design was based heavily upon that of the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Besh'' was tough and had excellent structural characteristics. It had decent speed, but was outmatched by most military or state-of-the-art vehicles. The [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was easier to fly than its [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] predecessor as a result of its design changes.<ref name="LECG" />

==Design==
Compared to the earlier B-wings, the ''Besh''-type had significantly scaled down armaments, along with numerous other modifications, to make the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] more suitable for private ownership. The cockpit was shifted toward the center of the fighter, with the engines placed toward the ends of the central wing. The B-wings rotating cockpit was eliminated, and the ''Besh'' had the cockpit in the middle of the starfighter. This was done to eliminate the disorientation caused by evasive maneuvers, and to help the pilot judge the dimensions of the ship in flight. It retained the folding [[S-foils/Legends|S-foils]] for stability.<ref name="LECG" />

[[File:Ht-Besh.jpg|left|thumb|250ppx|A ''Besh''-type fighter flying above [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].]]
The ''Besh'' was equipped with moderately powerful fire-linked [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] that were mounted on the end of the S-foils. While the weapon systems were scaled back in comparison to the B-wing, the underlying connections and internal design specifications were still there. Many [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]] used this to extensively modify their ''Besh''.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
The ''Besh'' resonated with individuals who longed for a time before the Empire came to be.<ref name="LECG" /> Since it was a private starfighter, it was often used by individuals and organizations who needed a tough ship to travel the more hazardous and less civilized parts of space.
